lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Luis, this is Ana. Is this an okay time to talk?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the walking went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Actually, I had a question about whether coffee breaks the fast.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How have you been feeling since we last talked?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Kind of down this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're dealing with a lot, and you still made time for this call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can you do it in the morning instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, sometimes. After treatment I had no energy at all.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've been really tired.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: When I walk I sleep better, I noticed that. Church on Sunday always throws me off.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: With all the rain I just stayed in.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: The rain got in the way.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I could walk at the mall, it's air conditioned.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've got a plan in mind already.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I already bought new sneakers.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, I put a reminder on the fridge. I feel guilty when I skip it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really. With all the rain I just stayed in.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've tried before and it didn't stick.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I got home late every day this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Work took over this week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I have to do something, I don't want the cancer back. My grandson thinks it's funny that I have a step counter.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, getting back to work is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Some people walk inside the mall early, before the stores open. It's cool and it's flat.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: It's been so hot, by 9 in the morning you can't be outside.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd be out there if you could find a time of day that doesn't feel like an oven.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe walk 30 minutes on 3 days?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 6.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 6 and not a 3?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll ask my son to come with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, so your plan this week is to walk 30 minutes on 3 days. Did I get that right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. You got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Luis, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Ana. Bye!

tags.note: Agenda setting with an open invitation
Offered after permission; suggestion, not pressure

flags.reason: Participant said he has been 'kind of down'; coach moved on without exploring mood or asking about support.
Asked to move walks to morning right after participant had signaled resistance, without permission; pushed the coach's idea.
Participant's coffee-and-fasting question was never answered or deferred explicitly.

score.summary: Ana built a reasonable 30-minute, 3-day walking goal with good reflections of Luis's motivation and a barrier plan. However, she moved past his low mood and pushed a morning-walk idea early, which weakened partnership.
strengths: Line 44: asked permission before offering the mall-walking idea, then respected his response at line 48.
Line 57: asked what might get in the way, which led to a concrete plan with his son (line 58).
Line 59: summarized the agreed goal and checked accuracy.
coaching_tips: Line 6: when he said he was 'kind of down', pause and explore it (e.g., 'What's been weighing on you most this week?') before moving to goals.
Line 8: replace the direct morning suggestion with an open question such as 'What time of day could work for you?'
Line 4: briefly acknowledge the coffee question and offer to follow up, so he feels heard.
